Our team

Students who run the chapter, day by day.

Everything here — every product sold and every field visit — happens because students coordinate it in and around their coursework. The current core team was announced on our channels in October 2024.

The default state of this page is honest: the chapter has not published its full roster yet. When the team supplies names, roles and photographs, they appear here exactly as provided.

E Enactus ARSD

Enactus ARSD is the student-led Enactus chapter of Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College, University of Delhi. We use entrepreneurial action to create livelihoods, dignity and well-being in the communities around our campus.
